sourceHeader.time: 1 Reaction, which you take when you or an allied creature in range takes damage.

system.description:
You manifest a spiraling helix of hardened air streams around the protected target. The Barrier has 2d8 + 10 hit points and 2 DR and lasts until the beginning of your next turn.

If this Barriers hit points are reduced to 0, all creatures within 10 feet of the protected creature, excluding you must make a Strength saving throw as the hardened wind quickly expands into an invisible explosion of force. On a failure they are pushed 20 feet away from the protected creature and are Dazed.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the barriers hit points by 1d8+4
